draft.heroMessage: Matching People With Homes Across Generations in Roanoke, VA
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome to Rocky's Mom Realty—where local knowledge and relationships have shaped trusted real estate guidance for over twenty years. Proudly serving Roanoke and surrounding communities.
draft.tagline: Turning Local Expertise Into Confident Moves
draft.aboutParagraph: As a Roanoke native and founder of Rocky’s Mom Realty, I’ve dedicated my career—beginning in property management in the 1980s and founding my real estate business in 2006—to helping clients at every stage. My business thrives on repeat and multi-generational relationships, grounded in communication, honesty, and an understanding of our local communities. Whether you’re buying, selling, or investing, I bring hands-on experience and deep neighborhood insight to each journey.
draft.conciergeLine: Ready to discuss your next move or curious about the Roanoke market? Let’s connect and make your real estate experience clear and rewarding from the v
draft.contactLine: Call (540) 400-5980 or email homes@rockysmom.com for personalized guidance tailored to your needs.

websiteDesign.heroTitle: Matching People With Homes Across Generations
websiteDesign.heroSubtitle: Explore Homes for Sale with Rocky's Mom Realty. View detailed listings, virtual tours, and personalized support to simplify your home search.

sections.title: Opening Doors to Your Next Chapter
